metadata.scope: Samsung Life hospital health insurance category policy decision

decision.reason: The current recommendation engine and insurance_products coverage_category enum support oncology, cardiovascular, metabolic, neurological, and medical_expense. Samsung Life hospital health insurance is an inpatient/hospitalization-style health product, not a DNA risk_target product and not a medical_expense baseline product. Publishing it under an existing category would overstate matching precision.

next_actions: Merge the source catalog exclusion seed change.
After merge, run production DB backup and seed apply in a separate PR.
Keep this product out of Dashboard recommendations and Concierge product context until hospitalization/general_health category policy is explicitly added.
